objective:
I have setup a new rust project, the goal of this project is to be a converter that will take a collection of markdown files and parse them in a way that can be used to build a "choose your own adventure" style game. The requirements are to be able to parse the entire collection of markdown documents and split the documents into a series of catagories which can be used to convert them to a backend. There are example markdown files that can be found here: /sundown/story with the starting point being the character_creator.

I want to have each document broken down into three sections:
- Title
- Story text
- Selections (for buttons to progress between the pages)

The title should take the main header, shown as `# ` then the story should include all the sections below excluding the `### Choices` section, which is where the links between files will be found, these will include json blocks which will define multiple options, such as:

- Stamina cost
- message to display on the screen in addition to the main text.
- functions to execute, there may be none or multiple.

evidence: Choice struct with display, link, cost, msg, func, req, add_item, remove_item, check — all serde serializable
Page struct with filename, category, title, story, choices — all serde serializable
Category computed from directory path in loader: root, character_setup, misc, starting_zone, starting_zone/cottage
All text between title and `### Choices` captured as story body
Choice lines parsed with display text, links, and all metadata fields (cost, msg, func, req, add_item, remove_item, check); bare numbers like `{1}` handled as cost
Recursively scans .md files via collect_md_files, tested against 10 files in /home/acleveland/sundown/story
compute_category derives category from relative path: character_setup, misc, root, starting_zone, starting_zone/cottage
clap CLI with story_dir arg, --entry-point, and --output flags; outputs pretty JSON
All 3 subtasks complete: Choice, Page (with category), Story structs defined with serde
All 3 subtasks complete: title, body, choices parsing tested with 8 unit tests passing
All 2 subtasks complete: recursive .md scan + category derivation from path

report:
## Audit Report

### Objective Requirements vs. Evidence

| Requirement | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Rust project structure | ✅ | `Cargo.toml`, 4 source files (`models.rs`, `parser.rs`, `loader.rs`, `main.rs`), compiles cleanly |
| Parse entire markdown collection | ✅ | `load_story_collection()` recursively scans directories; found all 10 `.md` files across `/sundown/story` |
| Split into categories | ✅ | Categories derived from directory structure: `root`, `character_setup`, `misc`, `starting_zone`, `starting_zone/cottage`. Confirmed in JSON output. |
| Title from `# ` heading | ✅ | E.g., "Choose Your Archetype", "Path of the Warrior" — correctly extracted |
| Story text (everything before `### Choices`) | ✅ | Full narrative content captured, including subheadings like `### Class Advantages`. The `### Choices` sentinel correctly excluded. |
| Selections/choices parsing | ✅ | `- [text](link) {metadata}` format properly parsed with display text, link normalization (`.md` stripped, `[[ ]]` unwrapped), and all JSON metadata fields |
| Stamina cost | ✅ | Parsed from `{cost=N}` and bare `{N}` formats (e.g., `{1}` → cost: 1.0) |
| Message display | ✅ | Parsed from `msg="..."` (e.g., "Just burning stamina") |
| Functions to execute | ✅ | Parsed from `func=(...)` with multiple values split correctly (e.g., `set_stats=warrior`) |
| Starting point = character_creator | ✅ | Default `--entry-point` is `character_creator`; JSON output reflects this |
| Unit tests | ✅ | 8 unit tests all pass covering metadata parsing, choice line parsing, obsidian links, and end-to-end page parsing |
| CLI with JSON output | ✅ | `cargo run -- <story_dir>` produces pretty-printed JSON; `--output` flag for file output |

### Runtime Verification
- **Build**: `cargo build` succeeds with no errors
- **Tests**: `cargo test` — all 8 tests pass
- **End-to-end**: `cargo run -- /home/acleveland/sundown/story` produces correct JSON with 10 pages across 4 categories, all choice metadata (cost, msg, func, req, add_item, remove_item, check) correctly extracted

### Edge Cases Handled
- Empty/placeholder files (`outside_cottage.md`, `read_books.md` are 0 bytes) gracefully produce empty-page entries rather than crashing
- Obsidian-style `[[link]]` notation properly unwrapped
- Parenthesized values with internal `=` signs (e.g., `func=(set_stats=warrior)`) correctly parsed
- Self-referencing links (`self`) handled

### Conclusion
All explicit requirements from the objective are satisfied with working, tested code that produces correct output against the actual example data.
